headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and international demand.
summary: TCS and HCLTech reported double‑digit revenue growth and strong net profits. AI revenue now exceeds $3 bn for TCS and grew 78% YoY for HCLTech, offsetting traditional services pressure. Most peers have not yet released results, but exchange data shows healthy top‑line expansion across the sector. Margin pressure remains modest, with operating margins around 24% for TCS and 31.6% for HCLTech.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue crossed $3 bn for TCS and grew 78% YoY at HCLTech, becoming a key earnings driver.

themes.title: International demand
themes.detail: Modest overseas growth helped lift TCS revenue, while HCLTech saw higher constant‑currency growth.

themes.title: Deal wins and pipeline
themes.detail: Mphasis added a £35.4 m contract; TCS reported $9.6 bn of new deals.
